preconditions.description: The number of castles n is between 1 and 40 inclusive.
The amount of liquid k is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(connections) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in connections)
preconditions.description: The connections matrix is an n x n matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(connections[i][j] == connections[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))

preconditions.description: No castle is connected to itself.

postconditions.description: The result is a floating-point number.
The result is between 0 and k^2/4 inclusive.
